description: Every www.nbrm.mk URL tested returned HTTP 403 — both via WebFetch (banki-en.nspx) and via curl with a realistic desktop Chrome User-Agent (platezni-institucii-...nspx, registar-na-institucii-za-elektronski-pari.nspx, ghodishni_izvieshtai.nspx). The domain is clearly live and freshly indexed by search engines, so this is a WAF/bot-protection hypothesis, NOT a dead site.

result.result_summary: Domain-wide 403 to non-browser HTTP clients; all nbrm.mk candidates in this slice are therefore URL-and-confidence only, unverified by direct fetch.

why_it_matters: Any production collector for this cell must use a real browser engine (headless Chrome / claude-in-chrome) or negotiated access; a naive requests/curl pipeline will silently collect nothing and may misclassify the entire central bank as dead.

description: portal.nbrm.gov.mk (surfaced in mk search results as a National Bank portal) returned curl exit condition 000 — no HTTP response, connection failed or timed out.

result.result_summary: No response; could be geo/IP filtering, TLS negotiation failure from this host, or a portal that has moved.

why_it_matters: If this portal is the interactive statistics/time-series front end, it is potentially the single richest structured feed in the cell. It must be re-tested from a browser and a different network before any conclusion is drawn.

description: I could not locate a distinct standalone page slug for the 'Регистар на платежни институции' (Register of Payment Institutions) itself, despite finding sibling registers (e-money institutions, payment system operators) and the parent hub. Two targeted mk queries and one bilingual query failed to surface it.

result.result_summary: Register is legally mandated (per the licensing/registers decision, Off. Gazette 289/22) and almost certainly exists as a page or PDF under the registers hub, but its URL was not observed.

why_it_matters: Payment institutions are the fastest-moving regulated actor class in MK; missing this register leaves a hole in the actor map. Must be resolved by browsing the registers hub in a real browser.

description: No machine-readable open-data endpoint (CKAN, API, JSON, data.gov.mk dataset) for NBRSM banking or payments data was found in either language. Local terms 'отворени податоци' returned nothing NBRSM-specific.

result.result_summary: Distribution appears to be HTML pages plus XLS/PDF attachments only.

why_it_matters: Collection cost and fragility are higher than for peer central banks; budget for document parsing rather than API ingestion.

description: The site uses a consistent '-en.nspx' mirror suffix, and EN mirrors were confirmed to exist for several pages (banki-en, stedilnici-en, bankarski_sistiem_na_rm-en, mipsdd77afa6-en, izvieshtai_za_finansiskata_stabilnost-en, platiezhna_statistika-en). However I could not confirm whether EN mirrors are complete or lag the MK originals, since no page could be fetched.

result.result_summary: EN mirror convention established; parity unverified.

why_it_matters: If EN lags MK, an English-only collector would systematically miss the newest disclosures — reinforcing that MK must be the primary collection language.

description: Attempted to fetch a full issuer index at https://www.mse.mk/mk/issuers/all and https://www.mse.mk/mk/issuers/companies; both returned HTTP 404.

result.result_summary: No issuer index URL confirmed. Individual issuer pages exist under /mk/issuer/{slug} (confirmed for komercijalna-banka-ad-skopje, nlb-banka-ad-skopje, unibanka-ad-skopje) and MSE site search at /mk/search/{term} resolves slugs reliably.

why_it_matters: Without the index, bank-by-bank slug resolution must go through site search rather than a single crawl entry point; slugs must not be guessed.

description: seinet.com.mk returned effectively empty bodies (only the title 'SEI Net') on both the root and an individual document URL via plain HTTP fetch.

result.result_summary: Content is present per search-engine indexing and per the MSE RSS feed which links these exact document IDs, so the site is live; the failure is a rendering/tooling limitation, NOT a dead source. Recorded as unverified, not dead.

why_it_matters: Collection design for the single most important source in this cell must assume headless-browser rendering or discovery of the underlying JSON API.

description: Searched for a KHV page dedicated to approved prospectuses / emission decisions for banks specifically.

result.result_summary: No bank-segmented prospectus register was located on sec.gov.mk. Bank emission approvals appear embedded inside the general Месечни извештаи and session announcements rather than in a filterable register.

why_it_matters: Bank capital-raise detection requires parsing narrative monthly reports rather than reading a structured feed — a real extraction cost to budget for.

description: Run languages were scoped to mk and en; no Albanian-language (sq) queries were run despite Albanian being an official language in North Macedonia and sec.gov.mk offering an AL version.

result.result_summary: Albanian-language disclosure surfaces are uncovered in this slice.

why_it_matters: Some regulator and issuer communications, and Albanian-language financial press covering Halkbank/TTK, may be missed.

description: No dedicated banking or payments association page was found under the Economic Chamber's finance landing page (mchamber.mk/mk/home/finansii). That page turned out to be a list of donor/IFI financing programmes (GGF, EFSE, EBRD GEFF/ENEF, EIF WB EDIF, KfW, WBIF) rather than a sector association hub.

result.result_summary: Fetched the page; it contained only external finance-programme links, no member lists, analyses or association publications.

why_it_matters: Prevents mis-routing the crawler to a dead-end landing page; the correct chamber entry point for this cell is the Здружение на финансиски организации page (zdruzenijainfo/14), not /home/finansii. The IFI links are themselves a separate (out-of-cell) lead.

description: The guessed MASIT members index URL https://masit.org.mk/en/members-en/ returned HTTP 404.

result.result_summary: 404 Not Found. Individual member profiles under /en/members-en/<slug>/ do exist, and a paginated category index exists at /en/category/members-en/page/N/ (13+ pages observed via search).

why_it_matters: The correct crawl entry point is the paginated category archive, not the bare /members-en/ path. Recording this avoids a wasted crawl branch. This is a moved/absent index, not evidence the directory is gone.

description: afd.mk (Alternative Financial Services Association of North Macedonia) failed to resolve via WebFetch (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND) despite appearing in search results with current-looking English and Macedonian content snippets from /en/ and /en/za-nas/.

result.result_summary: DNS resolution failure on a single attempt; site content is indexed and appears live.

why_it_matters: This is a hypothesis (resolver, geo-block or transient DNS), NOT a verdict that the site is dead. AFD is the only fintech/non-bank association found for MK and would be a significant coverage loss if wrongly dropped. Must be retried by the verification pass.

description: No publicly downloadable MBA sector report, banking-statistics yearbook or standalone position-paper PDF was located during this pass. Publication evidence was limited to references (MiCreS newsletter volumes, a financial-inclusion brochure and guidelines for banks) surfaced in search snippets rather than direct file URLs.

result.result_summary: MBA appears to publish mostly as web pages and event material rather than as a numbered PDF report series.

why_it_matters: Sets expectations for the collector: MBA should be treated as an HTML-diff source with occasional attachments, not as a PDF-report publisher like a central bank. Deep crawl of /w/mk/nastani/ is needed to find the actual attachment URLs.

description: No Albanian-language (sq) search was executed for association/chamber terms, despite Albanian being a co-official language and OEMVP publishing primarily in Albanian.

result.result_summary: Albanian terms such as 'Oda Ekonomike', 'shoqata e bankave', 'anëtarët' were identified but not used as query terms in this pass.

why_it_matters: Association material aimed at the Albanian-speaking business community (including member lists and event materials) may be entirely missed by mk/en-only querying.

description: The acronym 'СКМ' and the abbreviation 'skm.mk' are ambiguous in Macedonian search: skm.mk resolves to Стоматолошка комора (Dental Chamber), while СКМ is used for Стопанска комора на Македонија. Similarly 'МБА' collides with MBA (the business degree) in mixed mk/en corpora.

result.result_summary: Both ambiguities produced off-target results during searching.

why_it_matters: Query construction for this cell must pin acronyms with a disambiguating co-term (e.g. 'МБА' + 'банкарска' or 'банки'; 'СКМ' + 'стопанска') or use full names, otherwise recall/precision degrade badly.

description: Both mchamber.mk and fic.mk run legacy ASP.NET sites with query-string navigation (Default.aspx?mId=&htmlId=&lng=) and, on mchamber, embedded cookie/session tokens in paths (e.g. /(S(2wn2wc45pcvdrzi1cx3slzax))/default.aspx). Two parallel hostnames also coexist: mchamber.mk and mchamber.org.mk.

result.result_summary: Menu links are not stable, statically resolvable URLs; the same content is reachable under multiple host and path forms.

why_it_matters: A naive crawler will duplicate content, generate infinite session-id URL variants and fail to build stable document identities. URL normalisation (strip S(...) segments, canonicalise host, key on mId/htmlId/id parameters) is required before scheduling collection.

description: Direct WebFetch of https://finance.gov.mk/mk-MK/oblasti/finansiski-sistem returned ECONNREFUSED (95.180.140.116:443).

result.result_summary: No content retrieved from the MoF financial-system section on the first attempt. Search-engine results show the domain serving pages normally, so this is treated as a hypothesis of geo-blocking or bot filtering, not a dead site.

why_it_matters: The MoF portal is the highest-priority source in this cell; a collector must be configured with realistic headers and possibly a regional egress, and must not mark the site dead on a single failure.

description: Searched in Macedonian for a standalone national payments strategy document owned by the Ministry of Finance.

result.result_summary: No distinct MoF-authored 'национална стратегија за платежни системи' surfaced. Payments strategy in MK appears to be carried by the National Bank (payment-systems strategy/oversight) and by the ЗПУПС law plus EU-approximation programmes, rather than by a separate MoF strategy paper.

why_it_matters: Analysts should not assume an MoF payments strategy exists; the equivalent policy signal must be reconstructed from ЗПУПС implementing acts, the Reform Agenda, and NBRM documents (covered by the central-bank cell).

description: Looked for financial-sector-specific statistics published by the State Statistical Office (as opposed to the National Bank).

result.result_summary: ДЗС publishes by subject area and via MakStat, but the searches did not surface a dedicated 'financial institutions' statistical release series; monetary and banking aggregates are produced by NBRM (nbstat.nbrm.mk).

why_it_matters: Avoids duplicated effort: for banking aggregates the collector should target the central-bank cell's nbstat PX-Web, and use ДЗС for ICT-usage, business demography and macro context instead.

description: Official Gazette (Службен весник) full-text search and consolidated legal texts.

result.result_summary: Individual issue PDFs are openly reachable at /Issues/{guid}.pdf, but it is unclear from search results whether structured full-text search, the consolidated texts service and the mobile app require a paid subscription.

why_it_matters: Legal-monitoring cost and method depend on this; a subscription may be needed for reliable amendment tracking rather than PDF scraping.

description: No Albanian-language search was performed for this cell despite Albanian being an official language in North Macedonia and the State Audit Office branding itself bilingually (Enti Shtetëror i Revizionit).

result.result_summary: Run scope specified languages mk and en only; Albanian-language state publications were therefore not searched.

why_it_matters: Some state bodies publish Albanian versions; ignoring them may miss documents or mislabel coverage as complete.

description: Kapital (Капитал), the Skopje business weekly, appeared only as an English Wikipedia entry in results; no current live kapital.mk-style URL was returned by the queries run.

result.result_summary: Outlet exists as a title but its current web home was not established in this pass; recorded as unverified rather than invented.

why_it_matters: Kapital is historically the leading MK business weekly and would likely be a top-tier cell source; leaving it unresolved is a real gap.

description: No MK-language media coverage specifically about POS-terminal vendors, ATM fleet procurement, or card-personalisation contracts surfaced under the payments queries used.

result.result_summary: Payments coverage found was consumer-side (fees, outages, wallets), not supply-side/vendor.

why_it_matters: Vendor-side signals are commercially the most actionable; their absence in media means they must be sought in tenders/registries, not press.

description: This cell is scoped to mk and en only; Albanian-language MK outlets (a substantial share of the domestic media market) were therefore not searched.

result.result_summary: No sq-language sources collected by design.

why_it_matters: Bank branch/complaint/appointment stories aimed at the Albanian-speaking market may be missed entirely.

description: No fetch/liveness testing was performed on any URL in this slice; paywall, robots and bot-defence status for Bloomberg Adria MK, SeeNews and Makfax are inferences, not observations.

result.result_summary: All access_status values are hypotheses pending the deterministic verification pass.

why_it_matters: Collection design (RSS vs crawl vs licence purchase) depends on real access status.

description: No RSS/Atom feed endpoint was confirmed for any of the MK outlets listed; feed URLs were not returned by search and were not guessed.

result.result_summary: Feed availability unknown for all candidates.

why_it_matters: Feeds would make monitoring far cheaper and lower-risk than HTML crawling.

description: No Fitch or S&P rating action on an individual North Macedonian commercial bank (e.g. Komercijalna Banka, Stopanska Banka, Halkbank Skopje) was located in open search — only sovereign actions plus banking-system commentary inside sovereign reports.

result.result_summary: Searches returned Wikipedia/aggregator pages and sovereign rating items; no bank-level rating action surfaced.

why_it_matters: Bank-level external credit opinions may simply not exist for most MK banks (they are unrated), which means parent-group disclosures and NBRNM data are the only issuer-level substitutes.

description: Both major rating agencies' primary pages are registration- or subscription-gated; no fetch was attempted, so their live status is unverified.

result.result_summary: Rating detail is reachable in practice only via MoF mirrors, licensed wires, or a registered account.

why_it_matters: Any pipeline relying on direct agency scraping will break or violate terms; plan for mirrors plus a licensed feed.

description: Macedonian-language searching found no Macedonian-language edition of the regional/international aggregators in this cell (SeeNews, bne IntelliNews, Balkan Insight, European Western Balkans). MK-language results were dominated by domestic outlets (Meta.mk, MKD.mk, Makfax) and state sites, which belong to cell 13.

result.result_summary: mk query 'кредитен рејтинг Северна Македонија Фич...' returned only domestic MK media and government pages.

why_it_matters: Confirms the cell-13/cell-14 split is real: the international-aggregator channel is effectively English-only, so MK-language monitoring must be handled by the domestic cell.

description: The Vienna Initiative website (vienna-initiative.com) was inferred from EIB/BIS references and not fetched; its current URL and document library are unconfirmed.

result.result_summary: Referenced indirectly via EIB press item and BIS speech about the Skopje Full Forum.

why_it_matters: Should be verified in the deterministic liveness pass before being scheduled for collection.

description: No Moody's coverage of North Macedonia (sovereign or banks) was found in this pass; only Fitch and S&P appeared.

result.result_summary: Search results consistently paired Fitch (BB+) and S&P (BB-/B) only.

why_it_matters: If confirmed, the external-opinion set for MK is two agencies, limiting triangulation; a targeted Moody's/Scope check is warranted.

description: No dedicated North Macedonia payments/cards conference with a published sponsor list was found. Payments content surfaces inside general ICT, e-commerce, capital-market or regional-summit events, or in the one-off EACHA annual conference hosted in Skopje.

result.result_summary: Searched mk and en for a standalone MK payments conference; only EACHA (visiting European event), MASIT ICT forums, Macedonia2025 Summit, MSE annual conference and an e-commerce conference were identified.

why_it_matters: Sponsor-list intelligence for this market must be assembled from adjacent events rather than from a single payments show; collection design should cover several event families.

description: No public, itemised consumer-complaint register or statistics dashboard for banks/PSPs was located at the central bank or elsewhere in this pass.

result.result_summary: NBRSM pages surfaced consumer-credit protection material and banking-system indicators, but no complaints docket comparable to an ombudsman register; OPM offers intake forms, not published case data.

why_it_matters: Complaint-volume trend analysis by institution may be impossible from open sources; the fallback is qualitative theme extraction from OPM handbooks, media and any NBRSM annual-report sections.

description: No domestic North Macedonian banking/fintech award programme was identified; the recognitions circulating in MK press are all foreign (The Banker, Global Finance, EMEA Finance).

result.result_summary: mk query for 'банка на годината' returned only foreign-award coverage republished by MK outlets.

why_it_matters: Award signals for MK must be tracked at the international award bodies and mirrored through MK press; there is no local jury whose criteria could be mined.

description: Payten and Halcom were probed as regional payment-vendor actors with possible MK presence, but no MK-specific site, office or careers page for either was confirmed in this pass.

result.result_summary: Query returned CaSys as the confirmed MK processor; no MK-localised Payten/Halcom page surfaced.

why_it_matters: The MK vendor actor map is currently thin beyond CaSys and KIBS; a dedicated vendor-mapping pass (company registry, tender records, MASIT members) is needed.

description: No stable Macedonian-language term for vendor-named core-banking or card-management platforms was established; job ads use generic phrasing ('Сектор за ИТ', 'апликативни решенија') rather than product names in the snippets seen.

result.result_summary: mk hiring queries yielded department names and generic role titles; product names appeared only in English where present at all.

why_it_matters: Platform-identification from MK job ads will require full-text retrieval of ad bodies plus an English product-name dictionary, not mk keyword search alone.

description: Searches did not surface any national web-archiving programme for the .mk domain (e.g. a National and University Library 'Св. Климент Охридски' web archive or an MK legal-deposit web harvest).

result.result_summary: No MK national web archive identified; Internet Archive appears to be the de facto archival layer for MK bank and regulator sites.

why_it_matters: Without a national harvest, historical MK bank disclosures survive only through Internet Archive coverage, which is thin for JS-heavy IR pages and PDF-behind-form assets — argues for our own proactive save-page-now programme.

description: The open-data portal was confirmed to exist (data.gov.mk / otvorenipodatoci.gov.mk) but searches returned no evidence of dedicated banking- or payments-sector datasets published there.

result.result_summary: Portal exists; banking/payments dataset coverage unconfirmed and likely sparse.

why_it_matters: If the portal carries no financial-sector datasets, the reconstruction of time series must fall back on NBRM statistics and MAKStat rather than machine-readable open data.

description: No DSpace/EPrints-style open institutional repository for UKIM or other MK universities was identified; theses appear to be served as loose PDFs from faculty WordPress uploads instead.

result.result_summary: No harvestable OAI-PMH endpoint found for MK academic banking literature.

why_it_matters: Academic material must be discovered by ad-hoc site crawling and search rather than metadata harvesting, raising collection cost and lowering recall.

description: NBRM's /WBStorage/Files/ and bank /content/pdf/ stores are reachable by deep link but no evidence was found that directory listings are enabled, so contents cannot be enumerated directly.

result.result_summary: Deep-link retrieval works; enumeration must come from Wayback CDX or site: queries.

why_it_matters: Determines the collection method — CDX-driven URL discovery is mandatory rather than optional for these repositories.

description: No URL in this slice was fetched or liveness-tested; all entries are search-derived and awaiting the deterministic verification pass. Paywall/anti-bot flags are hypotheses based on each platform's known model, not observed responses.

result.result_summary: All candidates unverified by design.

why_it_matters: Downstream stages must not treat any status here as confirmed.

description: For Халкбанк АД Скопје I could not locate a distinct 'Односи со инвеститори' / 'За акционерите' hub; reporting appears consolidated under a generic 'Годишни извештаи / Извештаи' page (halkbank.mk/godishni-izveshtai.nspx), and dividend/financial-data notices reach the market through the MSE free-market announcement channel instead.

result.result_summary: Reports exist and are downloadable, but no shareholder-relations landing page was observed. Not a dead source — a structural difference.

why_it_matters: Collection for Halkbank must be seeded from the reports page plus the MSE issuer page, not from an IR-section pattern that works for KB/STB/NLB.

description: Fetching https://www.halkbank.mk/godishni-izveshtai.nspx returned site-wide product navigation rather than the report list; the report table did not appear in extracted text.

result.result_summary: Hypothesis: JS-rendered or frame-based report listing. Page is live (PDF children resolve), so this is unverified rather than dead.

why_it_matters: A naive HTML crawler will silently collect zero Halkbank documents; a rendering fetcher or direct /content/pdf/<year>/Reports/ enumeration is needed.

description: https://www.kb.com.mk/... returned HTTP 302 to https://www.kb.mk/... for Komercijalna banka's IR page.

result.result_summary: kb.com.mk is a legacy alias; kb.mk is the live host. Not a failure.

why_it_matters: Any stored historical URL under kb.com.mk must be rewritten to kb.mk or the crawler will log false failures.

description: For Силк Роуд Банка АД Скопје I found only the NBRM registry entry; no bank-hosted 'за акционери' or годишен извештај page surfaced in mk-language search within this pass.

result.result_summary: Unverified gap, not a confirmed absence — its own domain was not reached during this slice.

why_it_matters: A licensed MK bank would be missing from the IR corpus; needs a targeted follow-up fetch of its own website from the NBRM registry link.

description: Across KB, STB, NLB, Halkbank, TTK, UNIBanka, CCB, Sparkasse and Capital Bank, every annual-report/audited-statement artefact located in this pass was Macedonian-language; the Halkbank page read reported mk-MK as the active and effectively sole content locale.

result.result_summary: The cell's rationale is empirically supported: MK-language is the primary, and often only, publication language for IR documents.

why_it_matters: An English-only collection strategy would miss the majority of MK bank primary disclosure. Cyrillic percent-encoded URL paths must be preserved byte-for-byte.

description: This slice ran almost entirely in Macedonian; I did not systematically probe the English mirrors (/en/ trees) of the same bank sites to measure lag or completeness versus the mk originals.

result.result_summary: English-side coverage of this cell is unmeasured.

why_it_matters: Quantifying mk-vs-en lag is what justifies the MK-first collection design; it remains an assertion rather than a measurement.

description: OTP Group was listed in the cell brief as a possible MK parent, but no OTP-owned bank in North Macedonia was found. OTP's SEE footprint covers Slovenia, Serbia, Croatia, Albania, Montenegro, Bulgaria — not MK.

result.result_summary: No MK subsidiary identified for OTP in any search; MK bank lists do not include an OTP entity.

why_it_matters: Prevents wasted collection effort on OTP IR for MK segment data, and flags OTP instead as a potential future acquirer to monitor rather than an incumbent parent.

description: The brief suggested 'Silk Road/Şekerbank-type owners'. Silk Road Bank AD Skopje is owned by Silk Road Capital AG (Switzerland), not Şekerbank; the Şekerbank link is not supported by anything found.

result.result_summary: Ownership traced to Silk Road Capital AG following the 2016 purchase of Alpha Bank Greece's stake in Alpha Bank Skopje (ex-Kreditna Banka).

why_it_matters: Corrects the actor map before collection begins; a wrong parent would send the pipeline to an irrelevant Turkish IR site.

description: Silk Road Capital AG is a private Swiss investment group with no discoverable investor-relations or annual-reporting channel disclosing the MK bank as a segment.

result.result_summary: No parent-level IR site, annual report or segment disclosure found for Silk Road Capital AG.

why_it_matters: For this bank the cell's premise (parent IR reveals MK numbers) fails; collection must fall back on MSE/NBRM filings and the subsidiary's own reports.

description: ProCredit Holding reports North Macedonia inside an aggregated South-Eastern Europe segment rather than as a standalone reportable segment; a separate entity named ProCredit Reporting DOOEL (MK) is explicitly described as immaterial and not broken out.

result.result_summary: Country detail appears mainly as narrative (e.g. green-loan portfolio growth) plus CBCR tables, not as full segment financials.

why_it_matters: Sets realistic expectations for extraction: expect narrative mentions and CBCR rows, not a full MK P&L, from the ProCredit group reports.

description: The Steiermärkische Sparkasse Geschäftsbericht PDF itself was not located in this run — only the group's Southeast Europe overview page was found.

result.result_summary: German-language search surfaced corporate/overview pages and third-party profiles but no direct annual-report PDF URL.

why_it_matters: Steiermärkische is the parent of the merged Sparkasse+Ohridska entity (~13.4% MK market share), so this is the single largest open gap in the cell's document inventory.

description: The NBG Group investor-relations URL was inferred from NBG's known corporate structure and was not fetched or confirmed in this run.

result.result_summary: Searches confirmed NBG's majority ownership of Stopanska Banka but returned no direct NBG IR page.

why_it_matters: Stopanska Banka is the 2nd largest MK bank; its parent's IR path must be confirmed by the verification pass before any collector is pointed at it.

description: A possible sale of Stopanska Banka by NBG (to Steiermärkische or any other buyer) was probed and no evidence was found.

result.result_summary: No press release, filing or credible report of a divestment surfaced.

why_it_matters: Treat any such claim as unverified; the ownership map should keep NBG as the current parent until a primary disclosure says otherwise.

description: No free, machine-readable bulk download or open API of the Macedonian Trade Register or Register of Annual Accounts was found. Searches in Macedonian for отворени податоци / API / CSV on crm.com.mk returned only the statistical bulletin and the publications listing, both HTML-oriented.

result.result_summary: Bulk access appears to exist only through the contracted, prepaid Дистрибутивен систем and through BIFIDEX; free access is per-entity and explicitly limited to personal, non-commercial use.

why_it_matters: The MK statutory-filing layer cannot be scraped compliantly at scale. The collection design must budget for a licensed channel from the start rather than assuming an open register.

description: The exact public search endpoint of the Регистар на вистински сопственици (UBO register) was not located. All results were news/announcement pages about its launch and upgrades, plus a support contact (rvs@crm.org.mk, +389 2 3288 602). Whether the general public can search it freely, or only obliged entities and authorities can, was not established.

result.result_summary: UBO register confirmed to exist and be operational; access tier and query URL unresolved in this pass.

why_it_matters: Ownership data on MK payment-services companies is a core deliverable of this cell; not knowing the access tier blocks planning and could mean an FOI or contractual route is required.

description: Several crm.com.mk pages returned only a title or a maintenance notice to the fetcher: the /DS/ ASPX pages (Дистрибутивен систем), the /en homepage, and the Статистички билтен page (which served a Macedonian 'service temporarily unavailable due to parameter updates' notice).

result.result_summary: Content could not be read; hypothesis is server-side session/postback rendering or transient maintenance rather than dead URLs.

why_it_matters: These are exactly the pages that document the paid bulk channel and the sector statistics. A verification pass with a real browser session is needed before any of them is judged unusable.

description: Searched in Macedonian for a ЦРРСМ-published ranking of largest companies (equivalent to a '200 најголеми' list) derived from filed annual accounts. No such registrar publication surfaced.

result.result_summary: Only the Статистички билтен appeared as a registrar analytic product; company rankings, if they exist in MK, are likely produced by media/consultancies rather than the registrar.

why_it_matters: Removes a hoped-for shortcut to ranked financial data on MK banks and payments firms; ranking-type intelligence will have to come from BIFIDEX screening or from media/consultancy sources in another cell.

description: No public interface was found that lets you list all MK entities by NKD activity code (e.g. 64.19 banking, 66.19 auxiliary financial services, 82.91) — the free ЦРРСМ search is name/ЕМБС-driven only.

result.result_summary: Building the full population of MK payments-sector legal entities from the registrar directly is not possible through free interfaces.

why_it_matters: The cell's rationale rests on the registrar revealing the full population; that requires either the Distributive System, BIFIDEX industry screening, a reseller dataset, or the NBRSM licensed lists as a proxy.

description: Register of Pledges (Регистар на залог) and Register of Disqualified Persons (Регистар на дисквалификувани лица) had usable Macedonian names but no clearly discoverable English-language landing pages or dedicated public search URLs in this pass.

result.result_summary: Confirmed to exist via Macedonian sources and the DS catalogue; endpoints unresolved.

why_it_matters: Both are useful risk-screening layers for fintech partner due diligence; they need a targeted follow-up on the Macedonian site tree.

description: No dedicated public annual report or investor-relations page was located for KIBS AD or CaSys AD. Both are unlisted joint-stock companies; searches in mk ('годишен извештај КИБС', operator names + 'извештај') surfaced only registry aggregators, not an own-site report PDF.

result.result_summary: Operator-level financials appear reachable only via Central Registry filings / aggregators, not via operator IR pages.

why_it_matters: Means the A1 'annual reports / investor relations' topic cannot be served for the payments-infrastructure layer by direct disclosure; a registry-based collection route must be budgeted instead.

description: nbrm.mk returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to a plain fetch of the payment-institutions/e-money/system-operators register page.

result.result_summary: 403 on one attempt; the same domain's pages are indexed and reachable in search, so this reads as bot defence rather than a dead page.

why_it_matters: The NBRM register is the canonical actor map for this cell; collection must use a headless browser with realistic headers, not a naive HTTP client.

description: kibs.mk news page fetched but returned only the page header and the section title 'ВЕСТИ И ПРОМОЦИИ' with no item list or links.

result.result_summary: Listing likely rendered client-side; item URLs not enumerable via plain fetch.

why_it_matters: KIBS press releases are a primary signal for clearing-layer change; a JS-capable fetcher is required or the feed will silently collect nothing.

description: No evidence was found in this pass of an independent ATM-deployer / IAD operator active in North Macedonia (searched Payten/MoneyGet + mk terms 'банкомати', 'терминали'); MoneyGet hits were Serbia and Montenegro only.

result.result_summary: MK independent-ATM-network presence neither confirmed nor refuted.

why_it_matters: If no IAD exists, the ATM estate is entirely bank-owned and switched by CaSys — a materially different market structure that should be established, not assumed.

description: Searching mk terms for a domestic mobile/instant payment consumer brand ('мобилно плаќање', 'паричник', 'платежна институција') returned only international wallet launches (Google Pay, Apple Pay) — no branded national instant-payment scheme name surfaced.

result.result_summary: The instant-payment initiative appears still to be referred to programmatically (TIPS clone / иницијатива за инстант плаќања) rather than under a consumer brand.

why_it_matters: Keyword monitoring must be built on programme terminology, not a brand name, until a brand is announced — otherwise the launch will be missed.

description: Several licensed or newly licensed MK e-money/payment institutions (Flex Pay, MINT Fintech Group, and, in this pass, Paysera's MK arm) could not be tied to a confirmed corporate press-room URL. Their announcements surfaced only through mk media reproductions.

result.result_summary: Actor confirmed to exist; owned publishing channel not located in this pass.

why_it_matters: Collection for these actors must be media-mediated, which adds latency and paraphrase risk; the source list will look thinner than the market actually is.

description: mk queries combining remittance vocabulary ('дознаки', 'брз трансфер на пари') with 'соопштение'/'нова услуга' returned only static bank product pages for Western Union — no dated press releases from remittance operators or their MK agents.

result.result_summary: Remittance-corridor news appears not to be published as PR in MK; only tariff/product pages exist.

why_it_matters: Remittances are economically large for MK, so the absence of a PR channel means corridor change must be inferred from tariff-page diffs and NBRM statistics instead.

description: No established Macedonian-language term was found in use for SoftPOS or BNPL; searches had to fall back to the English-in-local forms ('SoftPOS', 'BNPL', 'одложено плаќање' untested).

result.result_summary: Local-language glossary gap for two of the cell's named product themes.

why_it_matters: Without correct mk terms these product launches will be missed by mk-language monitoring; needs a glossary-building pass with native phrasing variants.

description: The NBRM registers of payment institutions and e-money institutions are described in regulation and referenced on nbrm.mk, but the exact register listing URL was not isolated in this pass — only the governing decision page was.

result.result_summary: Register exists and is public; direct URL unresolved, not dead.

why_it_matters: This register is the backbone of the actor map for the whole cell; leaving it unresolved caps the completeness of any downstream actor list.

description: No Visa country newsroom or Macedonian-language Visa press page for North Macedonia was found. Searches in both en and mk returned only Visa global/regional newsrooms and MK bank product pages carrying Visa branding.

result.result_summary: Visa MK announcements, if any, appear to be routed through issuing banks and local media rather than a Visa-owned MK channel.

why_it_matters: Scheme-side coverage for Visa in MK must be built bottom-up from issuer pages and MK media; a Visa-domain crawl alone will under-report.

description: Targeted searching for MK bank customers of the large global core-banking and self-service vendors (Temenos, Oracle FLEXCUBE, Diebold Nixdorf, NCR/NCR Atleos, Euronet, BPC, OpenWay) surfaced no MK-named press release or case study.

result.result_summary: Only generic product/comparison pages and third-party customer databases returned; no MK deployment named.

why_it_matters: Core-banking platform ownership for MK banks remains unmapped; this is the single largest hole in the vendor picture and likely needs procurement notices, RFP archives, or job-ad/skills evidence instead of vendor marketing.

description: Macedonian-language searching for vendor references ('референци', 'решение', 'соопштение' + Македонија + банка) mostly returned legal texts, registry/company-profile aggregators and chamber listings rather than vendor case studies.

result.result_summary: Regional vendors publish in English; MK-language material about them is produced by media and directories, not by the vendors.

why_it_matters: Local-language crawling should be pointed at MK media and associations for vendor news, while vendor-owned collection stays English - splitting the pipeline by language accordingly.

description: Printec's MK country page was located but no MK-specific press release feed was identified in this pass; only a group-level blog and resources library.

result.result_summary: MK customer facts appear as prose on the country page rather than as dated releases.

why_it_matters: Undated marketing prose cannot anchor a timeline; deployment dates for MK self-service estates will need corroboration from another source class.

description: Neither Macedonian- nor English-language search surfaced a specific, currently-open tender for платежни услуги / банкарски услуги from a MK public body. Search engines index the ESJN's ASP.NET notice pages very poorly.

result.result_summary: Portal-level sources found and documented, but no individual banking/payment notice retrievable via general web search.

why_it_matters: Confirms that this cell cannot be worked by web search alone — collection must go through the ESJN's own search UI (or OCDS bulk data), driven by CPV codes and buyer filters.

description: A TED query for North Macedonia banking-services notices returned only an unrelated MK goods notice (road-marking machine, 200814-2025). No MK financial-services notice was located through general search.

result.result_summary: TED confirmed as a valid channel for MK notices, but banking-specific MK notices were not surfaced.

why_it_matters: MK is not an EU member, so its notices reach TED only above thresholds or via EU/IFI-funded procedures; TED should be treated as a supplement to, not a substitute for, the national portal.

description: The State Appeals Commission appears under at least three hosts — dkzjn.gov.mk, dkzjn.mk, and dkzjn.sorsix.com — with documents served from more than one. Which is canonical was not established, and no fetch was attempted to confirm liveness.

result.result_summary: Three candidate hosts recorded; canonical host unverified.

why_it_matters: A collector pinned to the wrong host will silently stop receiving decisions after a migration.

description: The data.gov.mk organisation URL for the Public Procurement Bureau appeared as a mojibake/transliterated slug (bnpo-3a-jabhn-ha6abkn), suggesting Cyrillic-to-Latin corruption somewhere in the portal or the index.

result.result_summary: Dataset list for BJN on the open-data portal not confirmed.

why_it_matters: Open data may be a cheaper collection route than scraping; its actual existence and freshness need direct verification before planning around it.

description: No Macedonian-language equivalents were used for the IFI/donor sources (EBRD, EIB, World Bank, WBIF, TED) because these bodies publish MK-related procurement in English only; MK-language mirrors of their notices were not found.

result.result_summary: IFI layer of this cell is English-only by nature.

why_it_matters: Local-language monitoring will structurally miss donor-funded financial-infrastructure procurement; the English channel is mandatory, not optional, for full coverage.

description: No dedicated 'набавки'/'тендери'/'добавувачи' or supplier-registration page was found on the websites of the systemic private MK banks (Комерцијална банка kb.com.mk, Стопанска банка stb.com.mk, НЛБ Банка nlb.mk, Халкбанк halkbank.mk, Шпаркасе Банка).

result.result_summary: Targeted mk-language searches on each bank name plus набавка/тендер/оглас за понудувачи returned only employment ads (огласи за вработување), product notices and financial reports — no procurement notice board or vendor-onboarding form.

why_it_matters: Confirms the cell hypothesis: private MK bank spend has no self-published tender channel, so the collection strategy must lean on IFI portals, gazette notices, trade press and financial disclosures instead of bank procurement pages.

description: No MK-specific commercial aggregator was confirmed to actually carry private-sector (non-ESJN) bank RFPs.

result.result_summary: tenderi.mk, etenderi.mk, servisea.mk and the foreign aggregators all present themselves around јавни набавки/ESJN data; private coverage is claimed by macedoniatenders.com and j360.info but was not observable without a subscription.

why_it_matters: Any budget spent on aggregator subscriptions should be gated on a coverage test, otherwise the run pays for re-listed public-portal data it already has.

description: Automated fetch of https://tenderi.mk/ returned empty content on one attempt.

result.result_summary: Single empty response; the domain appears in search results with live subpages (/tenders, /pricing).

why_it_matters: Treat as bot-defence or JS-rendered, not as dead; requires a browser-based or manual check in the verification pass.
